title: Instant Pot Keep-Warm Overuse
app: Meater probes, Anova Precision Cooker sessions, Instant Pot logs, wine-fridge sensors, ESPHome kitchen sensors, and pantry inventory feeds via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=instantpot:cook
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(keep_warm_min) as keep_warm_min by recipe _time
| where keep_warm_min>120
| sort - keep_warm_min
description: Uses Instant Pot cook history telemetry to monitor weekly accumulation of keep-warm time by recipe in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for meals that are staying parked too long after cooking, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Instant Pot cook history data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Weekly recipe chart of keep-warm minutes.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals weekly accumulation of keep-warm time by recipe so you can spot meals that are staying parked too long after cooking before it becomes annoying.
